findings.title: A run cut short after the trace moved but before .gitignore leaves norn's old line for good
findings.detail:
run() returns 'nothing to move' when repoLayout says new. D4 classifies the layout without looking at .gitignore. So a run killed between moveOldTrace and dropOldIgnoreLine leaves `.agents/norn/trace/` in .gitignore, and every rerun skips it. D6: 'Every step can run again, so an interrupted run is finished by a rerun'. But D6 also says 'On a new layout: nothing to move', so the spec itself is in tension here. The window is tiny and the line it leaves is harmless.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: on the new layout, still run dropOldIgnoreLine (and stage it) before reporting nothing to move, or accept this as is.

findings.title: entries() swallows every readdir error, not only ENOENT
findings.detail:
`catch { return []; }`: an EACCES on the old trace dir reads as 'empty'. migrate would then report success without moving the trace, and removeOldLayoutDirs would throw later. Smell: silent catch.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Return [] only when isErrno(e, 'ENOENT'); otherwise rethrow.
